name: qclod
description: Desktop shell for the Claude Code CLI
author: SOJuse

scripts.dist: npm run icon && npm run art && npm run build && npm run build:relay && npm run check:seams && node scripts/relay-manifest.mjs --allow-empty && node scripts/fetch-hysteria.mjs --platform win32 && electron-builder --win --x64 --publish never
scripts.release: npm run icon && npm run art && npm run build && npm run build:relay && npm run check:seams && node scripts/relay-manifest.mjs && node scripts/fetch-hysteria.mjs --platform win32 && electron-builder --win --x64 --publish always
scripts.dist:e2e: npm run icon && npm run art && npm run build:e2e && node scripts/relay-manifest.mjs --allow-empty && node scripts/fetch-hysteria.mjs --platform win32 && electron-builder --win dir --x64 -c.directories.output=dist-e2e --publish never
scripts.dist:mac: npm run icon && npm run art && npm run build && npm run build:relay && npm run check:seams && node scripts/relay-manifest.mjs --allow-empty && node scripts/fetch-hysteria.mjs --platform darwin && electron-builder --mac --arm64 --publish never
scripts.dist:e2e:mac: npm run icon && npm run art && npm run build:e2e && node scripts/relay-manifest.mjs --allow-empty && node scripts/fetch-hysteria.mjs --platform darwin && electron-builder --mac dir --arm64 -c.directories.output=dist-e2e --publish never
